disorder-name.detail: First-episode psychosis patients from GAP and OPTiMiSE studies. GAP patients met ICD-10 criteria including bipolar disorder, major depression with psychotic symptoms, schizophrenia, schizophreniform disorder, schizoaffective disorder, and psychosis NOS. OPTiMiSE patients met DSM-IV criteria for schizophrenia, schizophreniform disorder, or schizoaffective disorder.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A total of 295 patients with FEP (GAP N = 123, OPTiMiSE N = 172) were included"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Two clinical datasets: GAP (Genetics and Psychosis study, South London) and OPTiMiSE (Optimization of Treatment and Management of Schizophrenia in Europe, multi-site).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We included data from two large samples of individuals who were recruited and assessed at the time of their first presentation to services in the Genetics and Psychosis (GAP) study, and the Optimization of Treatment and Management of Schizophrenia in Europe (OPTiMiSE) study."

age.detail: Age statistics from Table 1 for all patients (N=295). Min and max not reported for the combined clinical cohort. OPTiMiSE inclusion criterion was age 18–40; GAP had a small number of patients over 45 (n=3), but actual range for the test sample is not explicitly reported.

sex.detail: Male N and % from Table 1. Female N derived by subtraction: 295 - 143 = 152. Female % = 152/295 * 100 = 51.5%. The paper reports male as 49% (rounded); exact calculation yields 48.5%.
